interface.shortDescription: Real-time intelligent context engineering that makes every prompt cheaper, faster, and context-aware.
interface.longDescription: grāmatr℠ is a patent-pending real-time intelligent context engineering layer that sits between you and every AI model you use. Every prompt runs through a multi-head classification pipeline that pre-routes the request, assembles behavioral directives and quality criteria, and pulls relevant context from past work — so the model skips orientation overhead and starts working immediately. It replaces the tens-of-thousands-token system prompt you'd otherwise hand-maintain, and the effect compounds the longer you work. Because the same contract — directives plus quality gates — runs on every prompt, behavior stays consistent and auditable across sessions, tools, and teammates: your AI acts the same on session 200 as on session 1, so you spend less time re-explaining and more time shipping. Works across Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, and VS Code.
